snippet.title: Resident Evil 7 biohazard and Resident Evil Village - Nintendo Switch 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Come face to face with unspeakable terrors once again as Ethan Winters.
Resident Evil 7 biohazard and Resident Evil Village have arrived on Nintendo Switch 2.

Release date: February 27th, 2026
Platform: Nintendo Switch 2
Genre: Survivial-horror
No. of Players: 1
Rating: ESRB M
Official Site:
https://www.residentevil.com/switch2
